item.title: Version 2.1.1
item.description:
## Fixed
- **Closing the lid stops the recording.** When your Mac goes to sleep, OpenOats stops recording and processes the meeting as usual; it finishes when you open the lid again. Before, the recording picked up again on wake and kept going into the same meeting. - **A call that's still on after wake asks again.** If you open the lid mid-call, you get the "Record this meeting?" prompt again. - **Processing right after wake no longer fails while Wi-Fi reconnects.** Cloud transcription and notes now retry for a few seconds when the Mac is briefly offline, instead of marking the meeting as needing attention.
(#780)
